newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P rates Socgen Australia issue at A1-plus.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P rates Socgen Australia issue at A1-plus.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp confirmed on Monday that it had assigned an A1-plus rating to Societe Generale Australia Ltd's series one A$1 billion residential mortgage-backed commercial paper programme.

S&P said the rating assigned to the Home Owner Mortgage Enhanced Securities Ltd series one issue was based on the strength of the transaction structure, the credit quality of the underlying assets, and the liquidity and hedging facilities from appropriately rated counterparties.

SocGen said on December 5 that it expected the issue would be rated A1-plus by S&P and also announced a A$1 billion mortgage-backed medium term note programme which it expected would be rated at least AA-minus.
